title: Grid Snake
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD · Space to Pause
description: Steer across the grid, collect fruit to grow longer, and switch between solid walls or wrap-around borders.

title: 2048 Tiles
controls: Arrow Keys, WASD, or Swipe · Undo Supported
description: Slide numbered tiles across the 4×4 board to combine matching values and reach the 2048 tile.

title: Brick Breaker
controls: Mouse or Left/Right Arrows · Space to Launch
description: Deflect the energy ball with your paddle to clear layered brick formations and catch power-up capsules.

title: Minesweeper
controls: Left Click to Reveal · Right Click or Toggle to Flag
description: Uncover safe grid squares using adjacent mine counts across Beginner, Intermediate, and Expert boards.

title: Meteor Blaster
controls: W / Up to Thrust · A / D to Rotate · Space to Fire
description: Pilot an agile vector fighter through drifting asteroid waves and split incoming boulders before impact.

title: Four in a Row
controls: Click a Column or Keys 1–7 to Drop a Disc
description: Connect four discs horizontally, vertically, or diagonally against a tactical computer opponent or a friend.
